title: Senior Manager - Accounts & Finance
jobDescription:
Role Overview Company: AFPL Group Position Title: Senior Manager
- Accounts & Finance Department: Finance & Accounts Location: Corporate Office Reports To: Head of Finance / Chief Financial Officer (CFO) Direct Reports: * Manager / Assistant Manager (Payments & Taxation) Manager / Assistant Manager (Bookkeeping & General Ledger) Employment Type: Full-time Job Purpose The Senior Manager
- Accounts & Finance is a leadership role responsible for directing the entire accounting, taxation, payment operations, and management reporting (MIS) functions across all AFPL group companies. This role acts as the ultimate custodian of financial integrity, ensuring absolute accuracy in the books of accounts, strict compliance with direct and indirect tax frameworks, and timely, controlled payment disbursements. As a strategic partner to the CFO, the Senior Manager will supervise a team of accounting and tax professionals, elevating raw operational data into highly analytical board-level MIS reports to drive group-wide corporate strategy. Key Responsibilities
1. Team Leadership & Operational Oversight Department Management: Lead, mentor, and evaluate a multi-tier team of accounts professionals responsible for bookkeeping, vendor payments, treasury, and taxation. Work Allocation & Review: Establish clear key performance indicators (KPIs) for direct reports, streamline department workflows, and run internal quality checks on all team outputs. SOP & Internal Controls: Develop, implement, and enforce robust standard operating procedures (SOPs) and internal financial controls (IFC) across all group entities to prevent financial leakages and fraud.
2. Supervisory Oversight of Taxation & Payments Taxation Oversight: * Provide strategic guidance to the tax team on the monthly filing of GSTR-1 , GSTR-3B , and the proactive utilization of GSTR-1A for mid-month amendments. Supervise complex tax reconciliations (such as GSTR-2B vs. Purchase Register) to maximize Input Tax Credit (ITC) utilization. Oversee Direct Tax compliance (Corporate Income Tax, Advance Tax, and TDS/TCS filings) and coordinate responses to tax notices and assessment representation. Payment & Treasury Authorization: * Act as a senior authorized signatory/approver for high-value corporate vendor disbursements, payroll files, and inter-company fund transfers. Monitor cash flow forecasting models prepared by the payments team to optimize group-level working capital.
3. Core Bookkeeping, General Ledger & Consolidation Financial Integrity: Review and sign off on monthly trial balances, ensuring strict compliance with Ind AS / IFRS / local GAAP. Inter-Company Consolidation: Oversee complex inter-company reconciliations, transfer pricing compliance, and elimination entries required to produce consolidated group financial statements. Asset & Inventory Valuation: Direct the physical verification and valuation audits for fixed assets and inventories across all warehouses/offices.
4. Advanced MIS, Budgeting & Business Intelligence C-Suite MIS Reporting: Compile and present comprehensive consolidated monthly MIS packs, summarizing group profitability, working capital health, cash flow run rates, and key business unit performance metrics directly to the CFO and Board. Strategic Variance Analysis: Drive deep-dive variance analysis (Budget vs. Actual, Mo M, Yo Y) to identify cost-containment opportunities and process inefficiencies. Budgetary Control: Lead the annual budgeting and forecasting exercise, collaborating with cross-functional business heads to consolidate financial projections. Automation & BI Integration: Drive the integration of Business Intelligence (BI) tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) with the ERP to transition the team towards automated, dynamic dashboard reporting.
5. Audit & Statutory Compliance Audit Ownership: Serve as the principal coordinator for statutory, internal, and tax audits, ensuring timely closure of audits with clean audit reports. Secretarial & Legal Alignments: Collaborate with the legal/secretarial team to ensure corporate compliance regarding board resolutions, filings, and statutory registries. Job Specifications (Requirements) Education & Professional Qualifications Minimum

EDUCATION:
Master's degree in Commerce, Finance, or Accounting. Professional Certification (Mandatory): Chartered Accountant (CA) or Certified Public Accountant (CPA) is highly preferred. Experience Overall Experience: Minimum of 8–10 years of post-qualification experience in corporate finance and accounting. Leadership Experience: At least 4–5 years in a core supervisory/managerial role managing a mid-to-large-sized team handling payments, taxation, and general ledger operations within a conglomerate or multi-subsidiary corporate structure. Key Technical Competencies Advanced Accounting & Consolidation: Deep expertise in Ind AS/IFRS, consolidation rules, and managing multi-entity accounts. Taxation Systems: Expert-level understanding of the Indian GST ecosystem (GSTR-1/1A/3B/2B), Income Tax provisions, and transfer pricing. Advanced Data Management: Mastery of ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, or Net Suite) and MS Excel. Strong familiarity with BI visualization software (Power BI/Tableau) is highly valued. Soft Skills & Leadership Executive Presence: Ability to comfortably present complex financial realities, budgets, and projections to executive directors and external stakeholders. Conflict Resolution: Strong leadership and conflict resolution skills to manage diverse task streams (Tax vs. AP vs. GL). Strategic Vision: Ability to look beyond basic bookkeeping to provide business-critical cost, cash, and tax optimization recommendations.

title: Manager - Accounts (Payments & Taxation)
jobDescription:
Role Overview Company: AFPL Group Position Title: Manager
- Accounts (Payments & Taxation) Department: Finance & Accounts Location: Corporate Office, Mumbai Reports To: Senior Manager (Accounts and Finance) Employment Type: Full-time Job Purpose The Manager
- Accounts (Payments & Taxation) will be responsible for overseeing, executing, and streamlining all payment processes and tax compliance activities across the diverse group companies of AFPL. This role ensures high accuracy, timely vendor payouts, optimal cash flow management, and strict adherence to local and international tax regulations (Direct & Indirect taxes). The successful candidate will play a critical role in mitigating financial risk, maintaining strong relationships with external auditors, tax authorities, and banking partners, and establishing robust internal controls. Key Responsibilities
1. Payment Management & Treasury Support Disbursement Oversight: Manage the end-to-end accounts payable (AP) cycle, verifying that all payments (vendor, payroll, utility, and capital expenditures) are accurate, fully supported by documentation, and properly authorized. Cash Flow Management: Collaborate with the Treasury team to monitor daily cash balances, project weekly/monthly cash outflows, and optimize working capital. Banking Operations: Supervise banking transactions, including bank reconciliations, managing payment gateways, processing wire transfers, and maintaining robust banking relationships. Internal Controls: Implement and enforce strict payment control policies, ensuring segregation of duties and prevention of fraud or payment leakages.
2. Taxation (Direct & Indirect) Compliance Management: Ensure 100% timely compliance with all applicable tax laws across all AFPL group companies. Indirect Tax (GST/VAT): Manage and oversee the timely, accurate filing of monthly/quarterly GST returns, including GSTR-1 (Statement of Outward Supplies) and GSTR-3B (Summary Return and Tax Payment). Actively utilize GSTR-1A for mid-month invoice amendments and corrections before filing the monthly tax liability to avoid interest or penalty liabilities. Conduct rigorous monthly reconciliations between GSTR-1/1A and GSTR-3B to identify and fix any discrepancies in tax liabilities. Oversee the deep reconciliation of GSTR-2B with internal purchase books to maximize eligible Input Tax Credit (ITC) claiming. Proactively follow up on, address, and resolve invoice mismatches and non-compliance issues directly with vendors to secure tax credits. Direct Tax (Income Tax & TDS): Manage timely computation, deposition, and filing of Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) and Tax Collected at Source (TCS) returns. Assist in the calculation and payment of Advance Tax, Corporate Income Tax, and deferred taxes. Assessments & Litigations: Draft replies to tax notices, coordinate representation for tax assessments, and work with external tax consultants on complex litigations or structured tax planning.
3. Financial Reporting, Audit & Group Consolidation Month-end Closing: Manage the accurate and timely closure of books of accounts concerning payments, provisions, and tax accruals. Group Consolidation Support: Facilitate inter-company payment reconciliations, transfer pricing documentation, and tax provisions required for consolidated group financial statements. Statutory & Tax Audit: Serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external auditors for payments and taxation schedules; ensure zero significant audit observations.
4. Process Improvement & Automation System Integration: Drive ERP (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Tally) optimizations to automate manual payment cycles and tax reconciliation workflows. Policy Formulation: Establish and update standard operating procedures (SOPs) for the payments and tax departments to enhance efficiency and maintain compliance. Job Specifications (Requirements) Education & Professional Qualifications Minimum

EDUCATION:
Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Finance, or Accounting. Preferred Certifications: Chartered Accountant (CA), Certified Public Accountant (CPA), or MBA in Finance from a reputed institute is highly preferred. Experience Overall Experience: Minimum of 6–8 years of post-qualification experience in corporate finance/accounting. Specialized Experience: At least 3–4 years in a supervisory role managing complex payment systems and tax compliance for a multi-entity group structure or holding company. Key Technical Competencies Taxation Expertise: In-depth, practical knowledge of current corporate tax laws, TDS, TCS, and GST regulations (including international tax/transfer pricing laws if applicable to AFPL). Strong familiarity with GSTR-1, GSTR-1A, GSTR-3B , and GSTR-2B reconciliation ecosystems. System Familiarity: High proficiency with Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems (Zoho Books, Tally) and tax filing portals. Excel Skills: Advanced MS Excel skills (Pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, data modeling, macro knowledge is a plus). Analytical Skills: Excellent capability to reconcile large, complex datasets across multiple bank accounts and business units. Soft Skills Communication & Negotiation: Strong written and verbal communication skills to interact effectively with executive management, tax officials, vendors, and auditors. Attention to Detail: Meticulous approach to verifying numbers and ensuring error-free submissions. Integrity: Highest level of ethical conduct, discretion, and financial integrity.

title: Credit Risk
jobDescription: About e Pay Later e Pay Later is a leading financial solutions provider headquartered in Mumbai. Since 2015, we’ve been at the forefront of delivering innovative credit products for businesses across India. Our mission is to simplify financial processes and empower businesses with access to capital through supply chain finance solutions and strategic lending partnerships. About the Role We are looking for a seasoned and strategic credit leader to join our dynamic team as the Senior Manager – Credit . This individual will head the credit function at e Pay Later, overseeing credit strategy, risk assessment, underwriting, and portfolio management for our own book and co-lending-based supply chain finance programs . Key Responsibilities Design and execute a comprehensive credit risk strategy for e Pay Later’s supply chain finance programs (own book and co-lending). Lead the development and implementation of credit scoring models and decisioning frameworks tailored to our products. Oversee the end-to-end credit lifecycle — onboarding, credit assessment, approvals/rejections, monitoring, and portfolio reviews. Minimize credit losses through effective delinquency management and targeted collection strategies. Collaborate with Product, Business Development, and Operations teams to ensure alignment with the overall credit strategy. Ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements, especially those related to supply chain finance and co-lending. Build and maintain strong partnerships with credit bureaus, data providers, and lending partners. Develop a high-performing credit team through recruitment, training, and performance management. Analyze credit performance data to support data-driven strategic decision-making. Qualifications Minimum 2+ years of experience in credit risk management, preferably in the Fin Tech or trade finance space. In-depth knowledge of credit risk analytics, scoring models, and decisioning methodologies specific to supply chain finance. Hands-on experience with credit policies and procedures for supply chain finance products (own book & co-lending). Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. Proficiency in data analysis and risk evaluation techniques. Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for innovation in financial services. Bonus Points Prior experience in the Indian supply chain finance sector. Understanding of co-lending structures and regulatory requirements. Familiarity with alternative data sources for B2B credit assessment. Expertise in handling large and complex datasets . What We Offer Leadership opportunity in a fast-growing and innovative Fin Tech environment. A platform to shape the credit strategy for disruptive financial solutions. Competitive compensation and benefits. A collaborative, passionate, and high-growth work culture. To Apply If you're a forward-thinking credit professional excited about transforming the B2B lending landscape, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Senior Accounts
jobDescription:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Senior Accounts Executive to join our Finance team at e Pay Later, a leading fintech platform. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of accounting principles, hands-on experience with reconciliations, invoicing, and reporting, and the ability to manage daily financial operations efficiently. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Manage and supervise day-to-day accounting entries, ensuring accuracy and compliance. Oversee vendor invoice processing, including validation, booking, and ensuring timely payment as per agreed terms. Handle e-Invoicing compliance, generation, and reconciliation in accordance with GST regulations. Prepare and file GST returns (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-2B reconciliation) and TDS returns (24Q, 26Q) on a monthly and quarterly basis. Monitor and reconcile input tax credit (ITC), ensuring proper documentation and rectification of mismatches. Ensure proper documentation and compliance for internal and statutory audits, including preparation of audit schedules. Stay updated on amendments in taxation laws (GST, TDS) and assess their impact on accounting processes. Coordinate with internal departments (e.g., HR, operations, legal) to support cross-functional financial requirements. Manage end-to-end bank-related activities, including opening of current accounts, coordinating with bank officials, and ensuring compliance with KYC norms. Requirements: B.Com/M.Com or equivalent; CA Inter or relevant certifications (preferred). 4–7 years of relevant experience in accounting and taxation in the service industry. Strong working knowledge of GST, TDS, and e-Invoicing. Hands-on experience with accounting software (e.g., Tally, Zoho Books, SAP, or similar). Proficient in Excel and capable of generating analytical MIS reports. Attention to detail, accuracy, and strong organizational skills. What You’ll Gain: Opportunity to work in a fast-paced and dynamic fintech environment Exposure to advanced accounting practices and systems

title: Senior Manager - Business Development
jobDescription:
Job Summary: We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Business Development Manager to join our fast-paced team in the FMCG/Fintech industry in India. As a Business Development Manager, you will be responsible for developing and executing marketing strategies to drive growth and maximize brand visibility through various channels. Your role will involve collaborating with internal teams, building strong relationships with channel partners, and implementing effective marketing initiatives.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Develop and execute channel marketing strategies aligned with overall business objectives to drive brand awareness and sales growth. Identify and onboard strategic brands, e B2B, cash and carry partners. Also, develop strategies to onboard distributors, retailers, and other relevant stakeholders, to expand the market reach. Build strong relationships with existing partners, to ensure organizational goals are achieved by conducting regular meetings, and provide the necessary support. Conduct market research and analyze consumer insights, competitor activities, and industry trends to identify opportunities and recommend actionable strategies Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop marketing plans, campaigns, and promotions to support channel partners and achieve sales targets. Create and deliver channel-specific marketing materials, including product collateral, sales presentations, and training materials, to support channel partners in effectively promoting our products/services. Monitor and evaluate channel marketing performance, including ROI analysis, sales data, and market share, and provide insights and recommendations for optimization. Stay up-to-date with industry trends, market dynamics, and regulatory changes that may impact channel marketing strategies. Collaborate with internal stakeholders to develop innovative marketing programs, incentives, and loyalty initiatives to drive channel partner engagement and performance. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field. MBA preferred. High level of enthusiasm, self-motivation, and a results-driven mindset. Proven experience of 5 years preferably in the FMCG, Retail, Telecom, e B2B, or Fintech industry in India. Excellent strategic thinking and analytical skills, with the ability to translate insights into actionable marketing plans. Exceptional communication and presentation skills to effectively engage and influence internal teams and external stakeholders. Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives and deliver results within deadlines. Join our team and take on this exciting opportunity to shape and optimize our channel marketing efforts in the FMCG/Fintech sector in India. Apply now and be part of our journey towards driving growth, fostering strategic partnerships, and making a significant impact in the market.

title: Assistant Manager - Accounts & Taxation (Fintech)
jobDescription:
Summary: We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Assistant Manager
- Accounts & Taxation to manage the organization's accounting and taxation functions. The candidate will be responsible for maintaining books of accounts, ensuring compliance with statutory requirements, and coordinating with tax consultants for TDS and GST filings. The role requires strong analytical skills, knowledge of taxation laws, and proficiency in accounting software. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
1. Direct Tax Compliance: Monthly computation and accounting of tax liabilities. Updating books of accounts with tax-related entries. Preparing and reconciling TDS data before sharing it with tax consultants. Reviewing TDS default reports and ensuring corrections through revised returns. Coordinating with tax consultants for timely filing of TDS returns (24Q, 26Q, 27Q). Ensuring timely issuance of TDS/TCS certificates. Preparing 26AS reconciliation for various entities before filing IT returns.
2. Indirect Tax Compliance (GST): Monthly computation of GST liability. Updating books with GST-related transactions and reconciliations. Ensuring Input Tax Credit (ITC) reconciliation with books and GSTR-2A/2B. Coordinating with vendors and accountants for ITC mismatches and corrections. Preparing and sharing GST data with consultants for timely filing of GSTR-3B & GSTR-1. Assisting in the preparation of data for the Annual GST Return and Audit. Coordinating with consultants for GST registration/amendments when required.
3. Accounts & Finance: Maintaining and updating books of accounts in Zoho. Handling general ledger activities, ensuring timely closing of books. Ensuring strict compliance with month-end, quarter-end, and year-end book closures. Performing bank reconciliations and accounts receivable/payable reconciliations. Ensuring compliance with Accounting Standards and Companies Act regulations. Assisting in the preparation of financial statements (Balance Sheet, P&L, Cash Flow). Monitoring supplier advances, outstanding balances, and aging analysis. Reviewing invoices and ensuring timely payments, including statutory payments like PF, PT, and other labor compliances. Assisting in internal and statutory audits by preparing and providing required data. Preparing the monthly MIS report after book closure, ensuring accurate consolidation of financial and operational data and analysis of variances. Verifying payroll data, including checking investment declarations and proof before processing payroll. Ensuring all statutory deductions and compliance requirements are met accurately.
4. Payroll: Verifying payroll calculations for accuracy and compliance with company policies. Reviewing investment declarations, proofs, and tax calculations to ensure correctness and compliance. Handling tax payments such as Income Tax, PT, PF, and other statutory deductions. Sharing salary data with consultants for TDS return filing and ensuring timely Form 16 generation. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): Timely and accurate reconciliation of tax data before sharing with consultants. 100% statutory compliance (GST, TDS, PT, etc.). Efficient coordination with consultants for tax return filings. Accurate and timely book closure and financial reporting. Effective reconciliation of receivables, payables, and bank accounts. Compliance with audit requirements and timely resolution of queries. Proactive identification and resolution of tax-related and account issues. Qualifications & Skills: Bachelor's/Masters degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance, or a related field; Inter CA preferred (but not mandatory). 7+ years of experience in accounts, taxation, and compliance. Experience in NBFCs, banks, financial services, or insurance companies will be an advantage. Strong knowledge of GST, TDS, Income Tax, and accounting principles. Hands-on experience with Zoho will be an advantage. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills. Ability to work independently and manage a team effectively.

title: Sales Officer
jobDescription:
Job Summary : As a TLO at e Pay Later, your primary responsibility will be to approach and onboard distributors and retailers, from sectors like FMCG, CD etc. in the assigned cities. You will play a crucial role in expanding the company's customer base and promoting the loan facility offered by e Pay Later. This position requires strong sales and customer service skills, along with a good understanding of the product and processes to effectively address customer queries. Job Role and

RESPONSIBILITIES:
You will be expected to : ● Approach distributors and retailers in the designated cities and on-board them on e Pay Later. ● Ability to make a sales pitch to convince the customer to avail the loan facility. ● Good understanding of the product / process to be able to respond to customer queries effectively. ● Collect the documents provided by the customer for on-boarding and ensure that all documents are as per the requirement. ● Coordinate with the merchant sales team to be able to create leads. ● Achieve the allocated targets for the territory. ● Regularly update your manager regarding the allocated tasks.
